# Internal leaderboard (dev tooling, regenerated by scripts/compare_runs.py)

Aggregates `results/history.csv` into mean +/- stdev per (algorithm, model, split, dataset) group, plus a task x algorithm pass/fail matrix and two diagnostics. Temperature is 0.7 by default, so a single run is never evidence -- only trust a difference between groups that exceeds the stdev shown here.
